## Problem

What concrete workflow or bug needs this change?

## Change and resulting behavior

Describe the behavior, including missing data and relevant roles.

## Verification

Commands/results, fictional reproduction and anything not tested. For UI changes,
include actual mobile/RTL/keyboard checks. Disclose substantial AI assistance.

- [ ] No secrets, private profiles, database files or unlicensed data included.
- [ ] Relevant behavior and failure paths tested; checks and formatting pass.
- [ ] UI keys include all supported translations, or the gap is explicitly discussed.
- [ ] Documentation, schema/migration and changelog updated when relevant.
